craft_notes: Sthāyin: tracing beginnings and ends. Device: end-dash→comma (midst stated softly, path released). Rejected: 'middle' for 'midst' — killed: midst holds between-ness; middle merely averages. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Alpha of all deeds, omega of all rites, the motley midst between,
thine indeed, O Master, on wit's highway.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇām paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi

reads_against.argmap: Beginning of all works, end of all rites.; The various inner happenings between — yours indeed, O lord, on thought's path. → All beginnings, ends, and betweens are yours on thought's path.
c1_essence: Contemplation-deed ennobles worm to Brahmā; beginnings, middles, ends are yours on thought's road.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
reads_against.l2: The start of every work, the close of every rite, the shifting play between — all yours indeed, O lord, along wisdom's road.
